translations.translation: The chessboard is not heaven, but earth.
He is the sea, and who struggles in him is his froth. From above, he is tossed and swirled. And who is this, who, in the form of a being, is not from him, and who is this who is not from him?
The taste of his poetry, in its grand and foreign splendor, was like the sun of forgiveness, bestowing light. He desired it, and all his songs were fists of steel, striking the heads of the ignoble.
The days of infidelity increased. Now, youth has laid loneliness upon my shoulders. Weary history advances on an unknown path, and we speak the words of the poet.
A crowd of jackals watches, who seek nothing but a stable, greed, and a trough for their bellies. We are far from grasping his words.
We, who are ignorant of the feast of divine love, following the marginalia writers and tomb-diggers of other lands, are busy with 'discussion' and 'examination' of the hidden ones.
Now, understanding the words of the Mathnawi and the Divan of Shams, complete alliteration, augmentation, deficiency, and omission. And we, in the idiom of today's 'intellectuals', are delighted.
We see that Professor Arberry, with another self-knowing soul, has called him the most poetic of poets, like Rumi.
But now, neither those who are so ignorant that they consider themselves incapable of understanding their own 'essence', nor we, who have given them up for lost, believe this.

This time, we have the courage to draw near to the essence of Jalal al-Din Muhammad's poetry. We will overcome those historical and literary causes and effects that, according to today's critics, are the cause of his poetry.
This is a transparent cup of wine, sevenfold.
It is not a constructed thing. And now, with the complex apparatus of existence and language...
